format: RFC3339 UTC with six fractional digits (zero padding is not added measurement precision)

configuration.semantics: Storage provenance only; never choose by display timezone or PostgreSQL session. UTC is permitted only for independently verified UTC-origin datasets, including original isolated UTC regression fixtures. This delivery does not change live environment or writer storage convention.

offset_policy: Explicit offsets preserve the same instant. Never strip Z, reattach +07, or compensate in FE.
null_policy: null remains null; missing remains absent; invalid absolute timestamp fails closed without guessing now or doc_no.
microseconds: Preserve available 0-6 digits. Runtime stock_documents.created_at precision 0 cannot recover subsecond information.

scope.P02_recent: Home recent uses P12 document reads; dashboard/summary KPI has no recent document timestamps and is not repurposed.
scope.P12_aggregate: Normalize each authorized source to UTC SQL timestamp before UNION, date filters, watermark, total, sort and keyset. PostgreSQL aware/naive types are inspected per source; SQLite deterministic scalar preserves microseconds.
scope.P04_P05: StockDocument serializes existing timestamp attributes from raw values instead of PHP-default ORM timezone. All model serialization consumers inherit this, including canonical reads; date-only doc_date and persistence/casts/getters remain unchanged.
scope.P05_sources_P09: Allowlisted Mini App list/detail response fields use the same helper. Existing read guards, ACL, PII redaction and request parameters are preserved.
scope.excluded: No normalization of stored historical receipts or unrelated nested scan/audit/media event timestamps. No new source mapping for checked/sent-to-web.

cursor.old_cursor: 422 DOCUMENTS_CURSOR_INVALID; reload cursor=start with the same filters
cursor.order: created_at instant, NULLS LAST, source_rank ASC, id ASC; secondary order is unchanged

cache: P12 aggregate has no internal result cache. Old serialized canonical cache entries retain existing short TTL; release verification must use fresh entries. No cache flush or business version bump.

live_evidence.required: Same authorized warehouse/session; sanitized actual aggregate and canonical raw HTTP for the three supplied UUIDs; each response request_id; deployed artifact exact SHA and preserved hotfix checksums; PHP/app/PG/schema timezone evidence. Source tests do not close this.
